custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.৫০ কাটা যাবে।

English-Wizard.question: ১) She is too tired to continue the work. (Compound)
English-Wizard.option1: She is very tired and canot continue the work.
English-Wizard.option2: She is so tired and cannot continue the work.
English-Wizard.option3: She is very tired and cannot continue the work.
English-Wizard.option4: She was very tired and cannot continue the work.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি simple sentence এ আছে।
- Too + to যুক্ত Simple sentence কে Compound sentence এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
- Too এর পরিবর্তে very বসবে,
- to এর পরিবর্তে and বসবে,
- tense অনুযায়ী cannot/could not বসে,
- to এর পরের অংশ। 

Simple sentence: The little girl is too weak to walk.
Compound sentence: The little girl is very weak and cannot walk.

Simple sentence: She is too tired to continue the work.
Compound sentence: She is very tired and cannot continue the work.

English-Wizard.question: ২) If he does not follow the rules, he will be punished. (simple)
English-Wizard.option1: Without following the rule, he will be punished.
English-Wizard.option2: When he does not following the rules, he will be punished.
English-Wizard.option3: Because of not following the rule, he will be punished.
English-Wizard.option4: Without following the rules, he will be punished.
English-Wizard.exp:
• If দ্বারা গঠিত শর্তমূলক না বোধক complex sentence কে simple করার নিয়ম : 
-প্রথমে without বসে+ ‘if’ clause এর মূল verb এর present form এর সাথে ing যোগ করতে হয় + ক্রিয়ার পরের অংশ বসে+ অপর clause টি বসে।
-Example: 
Complex: If you do not read attentively, you will not pass the examination.
Simple: Without reading attentively, you will not pass the examination.

Complex: If he does not follow the rules, he will be punished.
Simple: Without following the rules, he will be punished.

Source:  Advanced Learner’s by Chowdhury & Hossain

English-Wizard.question: ৩) Because of her illness, she missed the exam. (complex)
English-Wizard.option1: Since she was ill, she miss the exam.
English-Wizard.option2: Since she was ill, she missed the exam.
English-Wizard.option3: If she was ill, she missed the exam.
English-Wizard.option4: Besides of she was ill, she mised the exam.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Because of যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Complex-এ পরিবর্তনের নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Simple sentence এ because of থাকলে Complex sentence এ Since/ as ব্যবহৃত হয়,
- Subject বসে + Verb বসে,
- Adjective /Noun বসে,
- Comma বসে,
- অপর বাক্যটি বসে।

Simple: Because of his dedication, the project was successful.
Complex: Since he was dedicated, the project was successful.

Simple: Because of her illness, she missed the exam.
Complex: Since she was ill, she missed the exam.

English-Wizard.question: ৪) He works hard to prosper in life. Which kind of sentence is this?
English-Wizard.option1: Simple sentence
English-Wizard.option2: Complex sentence
English-Wizard.option3: Compound sentence
English-Wizard.option4: Compound-Complex Sentences
English-Wizard.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর: ক) Simple sentence.

"He works hard to prosper in life."
- এটি একটি Simple Sentence, কারণ এতে একটি মাত্র মূল clause আছে এবং সেটির সাথে একটি infinitive phrase ("to prosper in life") যুক্ত হয়েছে, যা মূল verb-এর উদ্দেশ্য বা কারণ ব্যাখ্যা করছে।

• Simple Sentence: 
- একটি Simple Sentence এ শুধুমাত্র একটি clause থাকে অর্থাৎ একটি subject এবং একটি finite verb থাকে। 
- Simple sentence সাধারণত In spite of, Despite of, Because of, By, Infinitive/ in order to ইত্যাদি দিয়ে শুরু হয়।

---------------
• Complex sentence:
- যে sentence এ একটি Principal clause এবং এক বা একাধিক Subordinate clause থাকে, তাকে Complex sentence বলে।
- Complex sentence এর subordinate clause এর শুরুতে সাধারণত if, though, although, as, because, since, so that, that, until, till, unless, when, why, who, which, where, how, before, after, whether, while বসে।

• Compound sentence:
- এ একের অধিক principal clause থাকে যাদেরকে co-ordinate clause বলা হয়।
- অর্থাৎ Compound sentence এ দুই বা ততোধিক principal clause বা co-ordinate clause থাকে।
- এছাড়া Compound sentence এ সাধারণত and, or, but, yet, so, therefore, otherwise, else, both --- and , either --- or , neither — nor, not only --- but also ইত্যাদি coordinating conjunction দ্বারা দুইটি principal clause যুক্ত থাকে।
-যেমন:
- The movie was really interesting, but it was quite long.

• Compound-Complex Sentences:
- A compound-complex sentence contains at least two independent clauses and at least one dependent clause.
- যেমন - Although it was raining heavily, they continued their hike, and they eventually reached the summit despite the challenging weather conditions.

Source: A Passage to the English Language by S. M. Zakir Hussain.

English-Wizard.question: ৫) Beside being a good student, he is a good player. (compound)
English-Wizard.option1: He is nothing but a good student also good player.
English-Wizard.option2: He is not only a good student but also good player.
English-Wizard.option3: He is a good student and a good player.
English-Wizard.option4: He is not only a good student but also a good player.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Simple sentence এ “besides being” থাকলে compound sentence এ “not only..….but also” structure ব্যবহার করে compound sentence টি গঠন করতে হয়।

Simple: Beside being a good student, he is a good player.
Compound: He is not only a good student but also a good player.

English-Wizard.question: ৬) He works hard so that he can prosper in life. [simple]
English-Wizard.option1: Because of he works hard, he prosper in life.
English-Wizard.option2: He works hard to be prosper in life.
English-Wizard.option3: He works hard to prosper in life.
English-Wizard.option4: None of these
English-Wizard.exp:
• So that যুক্ত complex কে simple করার নিয়ম:

- প্রদত্ত sentence এর প্রথম থেকে so এর পূর্ব পর্যন্ত বসে,
- so থেকে many/might/can/could পর্যন্ত উঠে যায়,
- to বসে,
- প্রদত্ত sentence এর বাকি অংশ বসে।

Complex: He worked hard so that he could prosper in life.
Simple: He worked hard to prosper in life.

Complex: He works hard so that he can prosper in life. 
Simple: He works hard to prosper in life. 

Source: Advanced Learners by Choudhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ৭) He is only four. [negative]
English-Wizard.option1: He is nothing but four.
English-Wizard.option2: He is nothing but than four.
English-Wizard.option3: He is not more than four.
English-Wizard.option4: He is none but four.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Affirmative sentence কে negative করার ক্ষেত্রে,

• বয়সের ক্ষেত্রে বা সংখ্যার ক্ষেত্রে only এর পরিবর্তে not more than বসে।

Affirmative: He is only four.
Negative: He is not more than four.

•  বস্তুর ক্ষেত্রে only এর পরিবর্তে nothing but বসে।
Affirmative: He has only a few books.
Negative: He has nothing but a few books.

English-Wizard.question: ৮) "A rolling stone gathers no moss" [complex]
English-Wizard.option1: A stone that rolls gathers no moss.
English-Wizard.option2: A stone what rolls gathers no moss.
English-Wizard.option3: Though a stone rolls, it gathers no moss.
English-Wizard.option4: Since a stone is rolling, it gathers no moss.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Participle যুক্ত simple sentence-কে complex করতে হলে participle অংশকে subordinate clause-এ রূপান্তর করতে হয় এবং বাকি অংশ main clause হিসেবে অপরিবর্তিত থাকবে ।
- প্রদত্ত বাক্যে 'rolling' হচ্ছে present participle,
- এর subordinate clause হল A stone which/that rolls.

সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর হবে -

• Simple: A rolling stone gathers no moss.
• Complex- A stone that rolls gathers no moss.

English-Wizard.question: ৯) I know you. [complex]
English-Wizard.option1: I know what are you.
English-Wizard.option2: I know you.
English-Wizard.option3: I know who are you.
English-Wizard.option4: I know who you are.
English-Wizard.exp:
Question: I know you. (Complex) 
Answer: I know who you are.

• Complex sentence: 
- যে sentence এ একটি Principal clause এবং এক বা একাধিক Subordinate clause থাকে, তাকে Complex sentence বলে। 
- Complex sentence এর subordinate clause এর শুরুতে সাধারণত if, though, although, as, because, since, so that, that, until, till, unless, when, why, who, which, where, how, before, after, whether, while বসে।

• Complex sentence এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
• Subject + verb + object - যুক্ত simple sentence কে complex করার জন্য ব্যক্তির ক্ষেত্রে relative pronoun ‘who’ ব্যবহার করে subordinate clause তৈরি করতে হয়।
- সুতরাং নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর হবে - I know who you are.

English-Wizard.question: ১০) It is certain that I support you. [simple]
English-Wizard.option1: Certain that I support you.
English-Wizard.option2: I support you it is certain.
English-Wizard.option3: Certainly, I support you.
English-Wizard.option4: I support you to be certain.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Complex sentence এ it is certain থাকলে Simple sentence এ
- it is certain এর পরিবর্তে certainly হবে + এর পরের relative pronoun টি বাদ যাবে + বাকি sentence টি বসবে।

Complex: It is certain that I support you.
Simple: Certainly, I support you.

English-Wizard.question: ১১) He speaks like a leader. [complex]
English-Wizard.option1: He speaks if he were a leader.
English-Wizard.option2: He speaks as if he were leader.
English-Wizard.option3: He speaks as if he were a leader.
English-Wizard.option4: He speaks lest he were a leader.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Simple এ like + phrase doing something থাকলে একে Complex করতে হলে as if/ as though + clause ব্যবহার করতে হয়।
He speaks like a leader.
- এটি একটি Simple sentence। এখানে একটা মূল verb ("speaks") এবং একটা phrase ("like a leader") আছে।

"As if + subject + were" — এই গঠন তখন ব্যবহার হয়, যখন আমরা এমন কিছু বলি যা বাস্তবে সত্য নয়, কিন্তু কল্পনায় সত্য ধরে নিচ্ছি।

Simple: He speaks like a leader.
Complex: He speaks as if he were a leader.

English-Wizard.question: ১২) Though he is poor, he is honest. [compound]
English-Wizard.option1: He is poor but to honest.
English-Wizard.option2: He is poor but honest.
English-Wizard.option3: He is poor and honest.
English-Wizard.option4: Since he is poor to honest.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Though/Although যুক্ত complex sentence কে compound sentence- এ পরিবর্তন করার নিয়ম: 
- Though/Although যুক্ত complex sentence কে compound sentence- এ পরিবর্তন করতে but/yet coordinate marker ব্যবহার করতে হয়।
- অর্থাৎ দুইটা sentence- এর অর্থ যদি পরস্পর বিপরীত হয় তাহলে but/yet দ্বারা compound sentence করতে হয়।

Complex: Though he is poor, he is honest.
Compound: He is poor but honest.

English-Wizard.question: ১৩) You must obey your teachers. [negative]
English-Wizard.option1: You cannot but obeying your teachers.
English-Wizard.option2: You cannot but obey your teacher.
English-Wizard.option3: You cannot help obeying your teachers.
English-Wizard.option4: Both B & C
English-Wizard.exp:
• Must যুক্ত affirmative sentence কে negative করার নিয়ম-
- must এর পরিবর্তে cannot but+ verb এর base form বসবে+object বসবে।

অথবা,
- cannot help+ verb+ ing+ object.

So নিয়ম অনুযায়ী দুই ভাবে sentence টি হতে পারে-
Aff.: You must obey your teachers.
Neg.:
- You cannot but obey your teachers.
- You cannot help obeying your teachers.

যেহেতু প্রশ্নে You cannot help obeying your teachers. দেয়া আছে তাই এটি উত্তর।
----------

খ) You cannot but obey your teacher.
- এটি "teacher" ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে, যেখানে মূল বাক্যে "teachers" ছিল।

English-Wizard.question: ১৪) Everybody hates a liar. [Interrogative]
English-Wizard.option1: Who does not hate a liar?
English-Wizard.option2: Who does not hate liar?
English-Wizard.option3: Who not hates a liar?
English-Wizard.option4: Who does not hates a liar?
English-Wizard.exp:
• Everybody যুক্ত বাক্যকে interrogative করার নিয়ম: 
- প্রথমে Everybody এর বদলে who বসে।
- এরপর doesn't/didn't বসে।
- verb এর base form এবং বাকি অংশ বসে।
- সবার শেষে অবশ্যই প্রশ্নবােধক চিহ্ন বসবে।

• Assertive: Everybody hates a liar.
Interrogative: Who does not hate a liar?

English-Wizard.question: ১৫) What a fool he is! [Assertive]
English-Wizard.option1: He is what great fool.
English-Wizard.option2: He is great fool.
English-Wizard.option3: He is a great fool.
English-Wizard.option4: He is a fool.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Exclamatory sentence এ What/how থাকলে assertive করার সময় what/how এর পরিবর্তে -
- Noun এর আগে great,
- Adjective এর পূর্বে Very বসাতে হয়।

যেমন - 
Excla: What a nice bird it is! 
Asser: It is a very nice bird. 

Excla: What a fool he is!       
Asser: He is a great fool.

English-Wizard.question: ১৬) Would that I could go to Brazil! [Assertive]
English-Wizard.option1: I wish I could gone to Brazil.
English-Wizard.option2: I wish I could go Brazil.
English-Wizard.option3: I wish I could go to Brazil.
English-Wizard.option4: I wish to I could go to Brazil.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Exclamatory: Would that I could go to Brazil!
• Assertive: I wish I could go to Brazil.

• Transformation এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Exclamatory sentence টি যদি would that দিয়ে শুরু হয়, তবে assertive করতে গেলে, 
- প্রথমে প্রদত্ত subject বসে,
- এরপর wish + would that এর পরের অংশ বসে।

যেমন- 
Exclamatory: Would that I could be a child again! 
Assertive: I wish I could be a child again.

English-Wizard.question: ১৭) As soon as the thief saw the police, he ran away. [negative]
English-Wizard.option1: No sooner had the thief seen the police then he ran away.
English-Wizard.option2: No sooner had the thief saw the police than he ran away.
English-Wizard.option3: Hardly had the thief seen the police than he ran away.
English-Wizard.option4: No sooner had the thief seen the police than he ran away.
English-Wizard.exp:
Affirmative: As soon as the thief saw the police, he ran away
Negative: No sooner had the thief seen the police than he ran away.

• As soon as যুক্ত sentence কে Negative করতে হলে:
• Structure:
- As soon as এর জায়গায় no sooner had বসবে,
- প্রদত্ত Sentence এর কর্তা বসে ,
- সে Sentence এর মূল verb এর past participle form বসে,
- sentence এর বাকী অংশ বসে + than + দ্বিতীয় বাক্য অপরিবর্তিত ভাবে বসে।

• Example:
• Affirmative: As soon as he saw the tiger, he ran away.
• Negative: No sooner had he seen the Tiger than he ran away.

English-Wizard.question: ১৮) Do or die. [Make it Simple]
English-Wizard.option1: By doing you will to die.
English-Wizard.option2: By doing you won’t die.
English-Wizard.option3: By doing you will die.
English-Wizard.option4: Without doing, you will die.
English-Wizard.exp:
Compound: Do or die.
Simple: Without doing, you will die.

• Do or die- এই sentence টি হচ্ছে Compound Sentence. 
• Or যুক্ত Compound Sentence কে Simple করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Without বসে + প্রথম বাক্যের মূল verb এর সাথে ing যোগ হয় + verb এর পরের অংশ বসে (যদি থাকে) + or এর পরিবর্তে (,) বসে + দ্বিতীয় বাক্য/বাক্যাংশ বসে। 
- এখানে দ্বিতীয় বাক্যে শুধু 'die' আছে বিধায় এটি future tense এ হবে। 

Structure: without + verb + ing + [,] + sub + extension.

English-Wizard.question: ১৯) The girl is very intelligent. [Exclamatory]
English-Wizard.option1: How intelligent the girl is!
English-Wizard.option2: How a intelligent the girl is!
English-Wizard.option3: How intelligent the girl!
English-Wizard.option4: Would the girl is very intelligent!
English-Wizard.exp:
• Assertive to Exclamatory করার structure:
- প্রথমে What/How বসে + Adjective বসে
- এরপর Subject + Verb + বাকি অংশ + Exclamation mark.

• বিঃ দ্রঃ Adjective এর পূর্বে  a/an থাকলে Exclamatory করার সময় What বসবে এবং এরপর a/an হবে।আর যদি Adjective এর পূর্বে a/an না থাকে তবে How দিয়ে Exclamatory করতে হবে।

Assertive: The dress is very beautiful.
Exclamatory: How beautiful the dress is!

Assertive: The girl is very intelligent.
Exclamatory: How intelligent the girl is!

English-Wizard.question: ২০) By taking physical exercise, you may be healthy. [complex]
English-Wizard.option1: If you take physical exercise, you may be healthy.
English-Wizard.option2: You take physical exercise, you may be healthy.
English-Wizard.option3: If you take physical exercise, so you may be healthy.
English-Wizard.option4: You take physical exercise, so you may healthy.
English-Wizard.exp:
• By/ In case of যুক্ত simple sentence টি যদি Modal auxiliary যোগে গঠিত হয়, তবে তা complex sentence এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
-  By/in case of এর পরিবর্তে  If বসে + 
- Subject বসে +
- Verb বসে + 
- Adjective /Noun বসে + 
- Comma বসে + 
- অপর বাক্যটি বসে
- আর মূল Clause টি Future/ Present হলে If যুক্ত Clause টি Present Tense হয়।

Simple: By working hard, you will shine in life.
Complex: If you work hard, you will shine in life.

Simple: By taking physical exercise, you may be healthy
Complex: If you take physical exercise, you may be healthy.
